name: Suou Risa
source:
"Well then, I'll have you return the favor I did you last time, with your body."

Finances manager who manages a finance company affiliated with the Kagebayashi group. Before Iwamori got acquainted with the group, she's already working under them, so she's kind of his senior.

Normally, she treats all the staff and customers with cold and level-headed attitude and is feared by everyone. However, towards Iwamori she's very frank and the two often plays around and teases each other like kids.

Her company fell victim to an organized loan and run situation, so she and Iwamori is currently working together to catch the perpetrators.

Being in an open sexual relationship with Iwamori, she often abruptly invites him for sex while working with him. Wanting to take the lead, she tries to take the initiative, but always ends up in the receiving role instead. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/6ninnotogime/chara4.html]Official Site[/url]]
